title: Introduction to Information Retrieval
author: Manning, Raghavan & Schütze
description: A classic textbook on information retrieval systems: inverted index, boolean model, vector space model, tf-idf weighting, and evaluation of document search results.

title: Search Engines: Information Retrieval in Practice
author: Croft, Metzler & Strohman
description: How search engines work in practice, from crawling web pages and indexing to query processing and ranking search results.

title: Information Retrieval: Implementing and Evaluating Search Engines
author: Büttcher, Clarke & Cormack
description: Implementing a text search engine, index compression, the probabilistic BM25 model, and measuring search effectiveness.

title: Discrete Mathematics
author: Rinaldi Munir
description: Logic, sets, relations, functions, graphs, trees, and combinatorics for computer science students.

title: Introduction to Java
author: Abdul Kadir
description: Object-oriented programming fundamentals in the Java language: classes, objects, inheritance, and interfaces.

title: Introduction to C++
author: Abdul Kadir
description: Learn C++ programming from scratch, including pointers, arrays, data structures, and classes.

title: Design Patterns
author: Arnold
description: Software design patterns for clean, maintainable object-oriented programming.

title: Relational Databases
author: Simarmata
description: Designing relational databases, table normalization, and SQL queries for structured data.

title: Machine Learning for Text
author: Pratama
description: Text classification with naive bayes and KNN, document clustering with k-means, and model evaluation.

title: Natural Language Processing for Indonesian
author: Wibowo
description: Natural language processing: tokenization, stemming, stopwords, sentiment analysis, and summarization of Indonesian text.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
author: Hadi
description: Building a question answering chatbot with RAG: document chunking, embeddings, vector databases, and large language models.

title: Dense Retrieval and Semantic Search
author: Santoso
description: Semantic search with sentence embeddings, sentence transformers, FAISS, and hybrid search combined with BM25.

title: Evaluating Retrieval Systems
author: Luthfi
description: Measuring search quality with precision, recall, f1, and ndcg using relevance judgments.

title: Linux for Developers
author: Nugroho
description: Terminal commands, package management, and shell scripting for software developers.

title: Growing Apples in Malang
author: Setyawan
description: A guide to growing apple trees in the highlands: seedlings, fertilizing, pests, and harvesting apple fruit.

title: iOS Programming for iPhone
author: Aditama
description: Building iPhone and iPad apps with Swift in the Apple ecosystem, from interface design to publishing.

title: Indonesian Cuisine
author: Rahayu
description: Traditional Indonesian recipes and a guide to legendary restaurants and cafes in Semarang.

title: Data Journalism
author: Yudhistira
description: Finding, cleaning, and visualizing data for news reporting.
